properties.description: The overall scheme comprises a data centre campus of up to three units (including server halls and cooling infrastructure, designed for an IT load of up to c.300MW across the three buildings (c.100 MW each), together with an integrated on-site energy generation centre and associated development. The energy centre will generate electricity from gas to provide resilient and reliable power supply to the data centre campus, mitigating pressure on local infrastructure and enabling the demand for data centre development to be met efficiently. It will demonstrate a viable pathway to become decarbonisation-ready. The gas connection to the energy centre is up to c.900 megawatts and, depending on the technology adopted, the maximum generating capacity of the energy centre is approximately 250-350 megawatts.

properties.address: The site of the project is located in Buckinghamshire, England. It is approximately 2km to the west of Gerrards Cross, approximately 2.5km east of Beaconsfield and approximately 1.5km north of Hedgerley. The site comprises land immediately to the south of the A40 Oxford Road and immediately to the north of the M40 motorway. It has a history of landfill activities and is currently operated by Veolia for the landfilling of inert building waste (albeit the site no longer accepts any forms of waste).
